results.title: GitHub - unclebob/swarm-forge: A simple tool for coordinating several AI agents.
results.content: SwarmForge is an agent coordination system that facilitates communication between agents working in different git worktrees. It provides role-specific prompts, worktree assignment, tmux sessions, and message passing. The main branch is documentary and runnable workflows live on pack branches.
